text:
Lord, this is my complaint—

you will understand:

I am dying of love,

but I cannot love.


I pursue perfection

in myself and everyone;

I pursue perfection

so that I might love.


I am consumed in my own fire.

Lord, mercy, mercy!

I am dying of love,

but I cannot love!

translation.title: Complaint
translation.editorial_note: The prayer's plain repetition and impossible contradiction are retained without ornamental expansion.
